item.title: Too many road users going up the one way street. Road making for no entry faded could be not helping., 16th October
item.description:
There are countless cars, motorbikes, cyclists and scooter users going up this one way street the wrong way when turning right from commercial street to Upper Bath street. This is an accident waiting to happen as the corner at the end is blind so road users turning left from great Norwood street are at peril as they cannot see these road users coming up the one way street. I had a look at the road markings today and thought maybe it’s not clear and the road marking is indeed very faded. I also think this needs some red or yellow hazard colouring to it too as food delivery riders are just ignoring it. Perhaps as they cannot see it in the dark. Please could there road markings be redone or at least topped up to make clear again? Another sign post would also be of benefit. I’m constantly telling road users they are going the wrong way and they look at me like I’m the problem! It’s for their own safety! Also bikes don’t seem to think it applies to them. Maybe make it clearer.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 13, Upper Bath Street, Ewens Farm, Cheltenham, Cheltenham
Report on FixMyStreet
